WITH claimed AS (
 SELECT id, CASE WHEN reconciliation_lease_until IS NOT NULL THEN $4 ELSE $5 END AS recovery_reason
 FROM refunds WHERE status=$6 AND provider_terminal_at IS NULL AND next_reconcile_at <= clock_timestamp()
 AND (reconciliation_lease_until IS NULL OR reconciliation_lease_until <= clock_timestamp())
 ORDER BY next_reconcile_at,id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT $1
 ), leased AS (UPDATE refunds r SET provider_retry_count=provider_retry_count+$7,
 reconciliation_lease_token=$3,reconciliation_lease_until=clock_timestamp()+INTERVAL $8,
 next_reconcile_at=clock_timestamp()+LEAST($2,power($9,LEAST(provider_retry_count,$10)))*INTERVAL $11
 FROM claimed WHERE r.id=claimed.id RETURNING r.*,claimed.recovery_reason)
 SELECT leased.*,a.provider_payment_id FROM leased JOIN payment_attempts a ON a.id=leased.payment_attempt_id

WITH candidates AS (
            SELECT id FROM seat_availability_outbox
            WHERE lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT $1::integer
        )
        UPDATE seat_availability_outbox event
        SET lease_token=$2,lease_until=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+($3::double precision*interval $4)
        FROM candidates WHERE event.id=candidates.id
        RETURNING event.id,event.session_id,event.session_seat_id,event.formal_status,event.formal_version

SELECT id, status
        FROM session_seats
        WHERE session_id = $1
        ORDER BY id ASC

WITH claimed AS (
            SELECT id, provider, object_kind, provider_object_id, local_reference_id
            FROM payment_provider_events
            WHERE status = $2 AND next_retry_at <= clock_timestamp()
            ORDER BY received_at
            FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
            LIMIT $1
        ), wake_payments AS (
            UPDATE payment_attempts AS attempt
            SET provider_payment_id = COALESCE(attempt.provider_payment_id, claimed.provider_object_id),
                next_reconcile_at = CASE WHEN attempt.status IN ($3,$4)
                                         THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE $5 END
            FROM claimed
            WHERE claimed.object_kind = $6
              AND claimed.local_reference_id = attempt.id
              AND claimed.provider = attempt.provider
              AND (attempt.provider_payment_id IS NULL
                   OR attempt.provider_payment_id = claimed.provider_object_id)
            RETURNING claimed.id
        ), wake_refunds AS (
            UPDATE refunds AS refund
            SET next_reconcile_at = CASE WHEN refund.status = $7
                                         THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE $8 END
            FROM claimed
            WHERE claimed.object_kind = $9
              AND claimed.local_reference_id = refund.id
              AND claimed.provider = refund.provider
              AND (refund.provider_refund_id IS NULL
                   OR refund.provider_refund_id = claimed.provider_object_id)
            RETURNING claimed.id
        )
        UPDATE payment_provider_events AS event
        SET status = $10, processed_at = clock_timestamp(), last_error = $11
        FROM claimed
        WHERE event.id = claimed.id
          AND (event.provider_object_id IS NULL
               OR event.id IN (SELECT id FROM wake_payments)
               OR event.id IN (SELECT id FROM wake_refunds))

WITH claimed AS (
            SELECT attempt.id,
                   CASE WHEN attempt.provider_status IN ($4,$5)
                        THEN $6
                        WHEN attempt.next_reconcile_at IS NULL THEN $7
                        WHEN attempt.reconciliation_lease_until IS NOT NULL THEN $8
                        ELSE $9 END AS recovery_reason
            FROM payment_attempts AS attempt
            WHERE attempt.provider <> $10
              AND attempt.status IN ($11, $12)
              AND (attempt.reconciliation_lease_until IS NULL
                   OR attempt.reconciliation_lease_until <= clock_timestamp())
              AND (attempt.provider_status IN ($13,$14)
                   OR attempt.next_reconcile_at IS NULL
                   OR attempt.next_reconcile_at <= clock_timestamp())
            ORDER BY (attempt.provider_status IN ($15,$16)) DESC NULLS LAST,
                     attempt.next_reconcile_at NULLS FIRST, attempt.id
            FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
            LIMIT $1
        ), leased AS (
            UPDATE payment_attempts AS attempt
            SET provider_retry_count = provider_retry_count + $17,
                reconciliation_lease_token = $3,
                reconciliation_lease_until = clock_timestamp() + INTERVAL $18,
                next_reconcile_at = clock_timestamp() + LEAST($2, power($19, LEAST(provider_retry_count, $20))) * INTERVAL $21
            FROM claimed WHERE attempt.id = claimed.id
            RETURNING attempt.*, claimed.recovery_reason
        )
        SELECT leased.id, leased.order_id, leased.provider, leased.provider_payment_id,
               ticket_order.total_amount, leased.currency, leased.recovery_reason
        FROM leased JOIN orders AS ticket_order ON ticket_order.id = leased.order_id

SELECT id
        FROM orders
        WHERE status = $2
          AND expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        ORDER BY expires_at ASC, id ASC
        LIMIT $1
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(MAX(EXTRACT($1 FROM clock_timestamp()-created_at)) FILTER (WHERE status=$2),$3) AS age FROM refunds GROUP BY status

SELECT seat.zone,inventory.status,count(*) AS count FROM session_seats inventory
            JOIN seats seat ON seat.id=inventory.seat_id WHERE inventory.session_id=$1
            GROUP BY seat.zone,inventory.status ORDER BY min(seat.row_no),min(seat.seat_no),seat.zone
